svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1049 commits across five public projects, 71 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-07-31 through 2026-10-22 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-22T00:59:39.155Z.
